violations.text: Chicken nuggets observed with temperature of 109 degrees F. Hot dogs observed held at 95 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Foods were returned to the high school (commissary) to be reheated to proper temperatures. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/28/2026

The doors to the outside, located near the milk chest coolers, are not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 02/12/2024
Hot hold box observed in poor repair. Gasket is not making a tight seal to ensure proper hot holding temperatures. Unit must be properly repaired/replaced. New Violation. Correct By: 10/05/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Employee has taken an approved course in food safety management and is scheduled for test. Once certificate is received, employee must be registered with RIDOH Center for Food Protection as Certified Food Safety Manager. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2024
